description: Folder taxonomy of the CoolSolve Library. A model's category is its parent folder under models/. Kind, level and status are facets stored in model.json (see docs/taxonomy.md). Change this file together with the folders (docs/taxonomy.md, section 'Changing the taxonomy').

categories.title: Fundamentals
categories.description: Thermodynamic basics: properties, closed and open systems, first and second law, combustion chemistry.

children.title: Properties
children.description: Exercises on fluid states and property functions: real versus ideal gas, constant cp versus property calls, two-phase states, densities.

children.title: Property libraries
children.description: Function libraries of thermophysical properties not built into CoolSolve: brines, heat-transfer fluids, single-fluid correlations, pseudo-critical properties.

children.title: Tanks and vessels
children.description: Rigid tanks and vessels: constant-volume heating and cooling, connected tanks, charge and discharge of a tank (uniform-state open systems).

children.title: Piston-cylinder devices
children.description: Closed systems with boundary work: piston-cylinders with springs or stops, isothermal, adiabatic and polytropic compression and expansion.

children.title: Steady-flow processes
children.description: First-law exercises on steady-flow processes: ideal and staged compression, mixing of streams, hydraulic power.

children.title: Second law and exergy
children.description: Entropy generation, exergy destruction, reversible work, Carnot engines and refrigerators.

children.title: Combustion
children.description: Stoichiometry, excess air and exhaust-gas analysis, mean specific heat of the products (cpbar), combustion chamber, adiabatic flame temperature, dissociation.

categories.title: Heat transfer
categories.description: Heat-transfer mechanisms and correlations, independent of a specific component (mostly function libraries).

children.title: Conduction, fins and radiation
children.description: Thermal resistances and shape factors, fin efficiency, radiative exchange between surfaces.

children.title: Internal convection
children.description: Single-phase convection inside pipes, curved and printed-circuit channels, near-critical fluids and engine cylinders.

children.title: External convection
children.description: Forced convection over plates, cylinders, tube banks, finned bundles, shell sides and packed beds.

children.title: Natural convection
children.description: Free convection from plates, spheres and cylinders, in enclosures and jacketed vessels.

children.title: Boiling and condensation
children.description: Pool and flow boiling, critical heat flux, film condensation, two-phase non-boiling flow, void fraction.

children.title: Pressure drop
children.description: Friction factors, straight-pipe and two-phase pressure drop, bends, tube banks and shell sides.

categories.title: Heat exchangers
categories.description: Heat-exchanger models and the methods to rate and size them.

children.title: Rating and sizing methods
children.description: Function libraries: effectiveness-NTU, P-NTU, LMTD and correction factors, zone procedures, shell-and-tube sizing, part-load UA scaling.

children.title: Single-phase exchangers
children.description: Single-phase counterflow, crossflow and generic exchangers rated by effectiveness-NTU, a constant effectiveness or UA-LMTD.

children.title: Plate heat exchangers
children.description: Plate heat exchangers: heat-transfer and pressure-drop correlations, thermal-resistance and three-zone condenser/evaporator models.

children.title: Zoned and discretised models
children.description: Multi-zone (pinch-based), finite-volume, moving-boundary and row-by-row discretised exchangers.

children.title: Condensers and evaporators
children.description: Air-cooled, water-cooled and shell-and-tube condensers, wet-coil evaporators.

categories.title: Compressors, turbines and pumps
categories.description: Models of rotating and reciprocating machines: compressors, expanders, turbines, pumps and fans.

children.title: Reciprocating compressors
children.description: Piston compressors: parameter identification, suction pressure drop, leakage, speed laws.

children.title: Scroll, screw and Roots compressors
children.description: Rotary positive-displacement compressors: semi-empirical scroll, screw and Roots models.

children.title: Compressor catalogues and maps
children.description: Compressors described by catalogue data and polynomials (ARI, EN 12900, manufacturer tables).

children.title: Turbocompressors
children.description: Centrifugal compressors: performance, power, performance maps and design similarity.

children.title: Turbomachine design
children.description: Similarity laws, specific speed and diameter (Cordier), axial and radial loss models.

children.title: Steam turbines
children.description: Steam turbines: isentropic efficiency, heat loss, wet expansion (Baumann), off-design (Stodola cone law).

children.title: Expanders and turbo-expanders
children.description: Scroll and volumetric expanders, empirical ORC expander maps, turbo-expanders and small gas or vapour turbines.

children.title: Pumps
children.description: Centrifugal pumps: manufacturer curves, similarity laws, dimensionless polynomials, variable speed.

children.title: Fans
children.description: Centrifugal and variable-speed fans: reference models and dimensionless polynomials.

categories.title: Other components
categories.description: Boilers, nozzles and ejectors, pipes, ducts, valves and flow meters, thermal storage.

children.title: Boilers and burners
children.description: Fuel-oil, gas and condensing boilers, modulating and on/off burners, parameter identification.

children.title: Nozzles, diffusers and ejectors
children.description: Isentropic and steam nozzles, critical flow, diffusers, single- and two-phase ejectors.

children.title: Pipes, valves and flow meters
children.description: Pipe and duct models, valve authority, orifice plates and nozzle flow measurement.

children.title: Thermal storage
children.description: Hot-water and ice storage tanks (dynamic).

categories.title: Power cycles
categories.description: Thermodynamic power cycles: steam Rankine, organic Rankine, gas turbines, jet propulsion, supercritical CO2 and combined cycles.

children.title: Steam power plants
children.description: Simple steam Rankine cycles and plants: component balances, cooling by a river, part load.

children.title: Reheat and regenerative steam cycles
children.description: Steam cycles with reheat, extractions and feedwater heaters, solar steam plant.

children.title: Organic Rankine cycles
children.description: ORC design points: simple, recuperated, with extraction, double-stage plants, power ratios.

children.title: ORC off-design and applications
children.description: ORC off-design and charge, waste-heat recovery and biomass CHP.

children.title: Gas turbine cycles
children.description: Brayton cycles and gas turbines at design: open cycle, intercooling, reheat, regeneration, inlet cooling.

children.title: Gas turbines off design
children.description: Gas turbines at part load and any regime: reduced quantities, compressor and expander maps.

children.title: Jet propulsion
children.description: Turbojets: ideal, with component efficiencies, with afterburner.

children.title: Supercritical and combined cycles
children.description: Supercritical CO2 cycles and combined gas-steam cycles.

categories.title: Engines
categories.description: Reciprocating internal-combustion engines: ideal cycles, engine and boost models, sizing, performance and emissions.

children.title: Air-standard cycles
children.description: Ideal-gas Otto, Diesel and Stirling cycles.

children.title: Engine and boost models
children.description: Crank-angle and operating-point models of gas engines; supercharged and turbocharged engines (air flow, compressor and turbine matching).

children.title: Engine sizing
children.description: Cylinder count and geometry, intake valves, valve timing, fuel injection.

children.title: Performance and emissions
children.description: Dynamometer tests, data-sheet coherence, bsfc, ISO 3046 derating, fuel consumption, exhaust emissions and CO2 per km.

categories.title: Refrigeration and heat pumps
categories.description: Vapour-compression, gas and absorption refrigeration cycles and heat pumps.

children.title: Refrigeration cycles
children.description: Basic vapour-compression refrigeration cycles: compressor models, volume ratio, losses, unloaded cylinders.

children.title: Refrigeration systems and chillers
children.description: Chillers, domestic refrigerators, CO2 booster systems, reverse Brayton air cycles.

children.title: Absorption chillers
children.description: LiBr-water and ammonia-water absorption cycles.

children.title: Heat pump cycles
children.description: Basic heat pump cycles: COP, second-law efficiency, pinch-sized exchangers.

children.title: Heat pump systems
children.description: Air-source, brine-to-water and inverter heat pumps from component and catalogue models, zeotropic mixtures.

children.title: High-temperature heat pumps
children.description: Industrial heat pumps with a sink at about 80 °C and above: cascade, two-stage NH3, R245fa, R1336mzz(Z), Brayton.

categories.title: HVAC
categories.description: Heating, ventilation and air conditioning: moist air, coils, air handling, cooling towers.

children.title: Psychrometrics
children.description: Moist-air states, adiabatic mixing, saturation, wet bulb, steam injection.

children.title: Cooling coils
children.description: Air cooling and dehumidifying coils: contact factor, dry and wet regimes, control, reheat.

children.title: Air handling
children.description: Air handling units, humidifiers, heating coils and heat-recovery loops.

children.title: Cooling towers
children.description: Wet cooling towers: direct contact, catalogue data, fan speed and air-flow control.

children.title: Evaporative condensers and fluid coolers
children.description: Evaporative condensers and indirect-contact cooling towers (fluid coolers).

categories.title: Buildings
categories.description: Building thermal models, terminal units and comfort.

categories.title: Renewables
categories.description: Solar collectors and geometry, photovoltaic modules, solar ORC, ground-source boreholes.

categories.title: Energy systems
categories.description: Cogeneration, district heating, hydrogen and the economics of energy investments.
